name: Product Demo Director
oneLiner: An open-source video pipeline that lets Claude Code or Codex turn a product brief, brand, verified claims, and raw footage into a narrated, edited, QA-verified demo.
audience: founders and product teams who have screen recordings but not a publishable product story
inputs: raw footage or a capturable URL
agentRole: Claude Code or Codex inspects the evidence, writes the story contract, captures missing states, generates voice and music, directs the edit, renders the artifact, and runs deterministic QA.
transformation: raw recording in; directed, source-bound product story out
